interactions.notes: Went to 10 rounds because llama3.2 claimed deal-done in prose while packages still mismatched (e.g. ERC 2% vs 3%) and then burned rounds on thank-you / post-deal admin chatter without a machine-readable accept (consensus_reached true). JsonConsensusTermination never fired, so MaxMessageTermination exhausted the budget. Middleman fairness acted as the safety net: locked an in-range fair package and both sides ratified it.
